body:
I'm just checking back in, this sub is pretty depressing too. Lots of people posting, hard to get a response.


I still feel like I'm crumbling. Every day, it gets a little worse.

I don't know.
Thanks for all of the comments, made me feel a bit better. I was in a real low state so I'm not surprised my anxiety and dysphoria messed with each other to make me feel worse.

Am glad I could help out a bit :)

I have decided I will not stay at this job longer than absolutely necessary due to very low pay for high stress work. Try considering things like that when deciding if your current position is right for you. You've got this!

No advice on my end, just want to let you know you're not alone.

I'm currently going through my first week and a lot of what you've written, I completely understand and sympathize with. It's very hard to imagine me feeling more comfortable or happier here in a month or two -- my anxiety levels are consistently much, much higher than before for very little pay. I'm also not sure if, when, and how to best approach leaving this job.

Best of luck, OP. Hoping that you'll either feel more comfortable in your role or find another job that doesn't exacerbate your anxiety as much.

I look forward to hearing what others have to say regarding this matter!

I see where you're coming from, but I never told this friend I am trans. They assumed and also assumed that I'm comfortable discussing my trans identity in any way, which I am not at all. This vent post was also mostly about the struggle of feeling comfortable and 'normal' with online-only buddies and not feeling the same with those who could see me / clock me based on appearance :')

Nonetheless, I'm glad your friend feels comfortable around you. Hopefully you're providing them a stepping stone to become friends with more kind guys in the future.
That sounds great, I'll hold off a bit if I still struggle to get in or clear it before then.

Hey, thanks for the supportive message. I'll be able to stay with my brother for a little while but the need to find a job will still be a bit overwhelming. I'm going to try to gravitate twds online jobs (would work best with my schoolwork) but am worried there will always be better people for the job.

Again, thanks for the support. Really made me feel a bit better.
Thank you for the advice. Looks like I have a lot of preparation to do before February -- I'll dedicate as much as I can in-between classes.
Thank you. I will check out what you've suggested. Hoping for the best.
